shape.text: A JSON Web Token in compact serialization (RFC 7519) is three parts separated by dots, each URL-safe base64 (so + and / are outside the grammar), and the header decodes to a JSON object. The secret is the whole compact serialization.

issuance.text: No provider is involved: a token is minted locally by any JWT library.

unresolved.reason: No source is cited; this is a statement about how synthetic examples are made.

collisions.text: Ordinary dotted identifiers and forms missing the signature part are not tokens of this family.
